title: Current AI Use Cases in Games
description: A consolidated catalogue of shipped, announced, and community-built AI systems in games mentioned in AI Existing Uses.pdf. It distinguishes conventional authored game AI, procedural simulation, machine learning, and generative AI.
methodology: Where the document described a use, the entry preserves and clarifies that claim. Where it named a game without explaining the AI implementation, the entry uses linked official, developer, GDC, patent, academic, or reputable technical sources. Unconfirmed claims are explicitly labelled.

patterns.title: Authored decision systems still dominate
patterns.content: GOAP, behavior trees, utility scoring, finite-state machines, perception models, and designer-authored rules remain the core of most shipped game AI. F.E.A.R., Halo 2, Dishonored 2, Alien: Isolation, and GROUND BRANCH show how these techniques create behavior that appears intelligent without machine learning.

patterns.title: Persistent simulation creates emergent stories
patterns.content: A-Life, Radiant AI, the Nemesis System, AI Storytellers, and procedural citizen systems simulate agents or world state beyond a single encounter. Their value is not generated dialogue alone, but relationships, schedules, memory, hierarchy, and consequences that persist over time.

patterns.title: Adaptation increasingly targets the individual player
patterns.content: Directors, preparedness systems, predictive traps, adaptive difficulty, and personalized audio respond to play style or current performance. Left 4 Dead, Metal Gear Solid V, Will You Snail?, and RimWorld use different forms of player-responsive pacing without requiring generative AI.
games: Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain

patterns.title: Machine learning is strongest in bounded subsystems
patterns.content: Confirmed machine-learning deployments are typically narrow and testable, such as ARC Raiders' learned locomotion or generative language in AI Dungeon and Mantella. This differs from unsupported claims that entire NPC populations learn freely at runtime.

patterns.title: AI also changes production, not only gameplay
patterns.content: Generative image tools, automated testing, dialogue assistance, animation prediction, voice synthesis, and asset generation increasingly support development pipelines. High on Life is a documented shipped example of Midjourney-assisted art, while Ubisoft Ghostwriter and Xbox QA illustrate broader production use.

games.summary: Enemy soldiers plan action sequences at runtime, selecting cover, suppression, repositioning, smart-object use, and recovery actions as circumstances change.
games.details: F.E.A.R. combines STRIPS-inspired GOAP with pathfinding, animation, smart objects, squad orders, and contextual dialogue. The system's emergent replanning makes enemies appear to flank or coordinate even though those outcomes often arise from cover selection and level geometry rather than a single scripted flank command.

sources.label: Jeff Orkin - Three States and a Plan: The AI of F.E.A.R. (GDC 2006)

games.summary: Combatants select self-preservation, search, vehicle, combat, and character-specific behaviors through a hierarchical decision structure informed by imperfect knowledge of the world.
games.details: Designer-authored orders, styles, squads, firing positions, stimulus responses, and perceived-world records let Halo 2 combine tactical autonomy with controlled encounter design. The architecture is commonly recognised as an important predecessor to modern behavior trees.

sources.label: Damian Isla - Handling Complexity in the Halo 2 AI (GDC 2005)

games.summary: NPCs follow schedules and goals for work, food, travel, social activity, and sleep, selecting actions and usable objects instead of relying on a script for every movement.
games.details: Radiant AI gave non-player characters packages and goals that could resolve through different objects or routes. The retail implementation was constrained compared with early demonstrations, but it established Bethesda's schedule-driven approach to populated worlds.

sources.label: IGN - The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion interview

games.summary: Conditional AI packages control travel, patrols, guards, sandbox activity, eating, sleeping, following, dialogue, ambushes, fleeing, and object use.
games.details: The package system combines schedules, conditions, navigation, greetings, conversations, combat continuation, and off-screen processing to generate everyday routines and quest behavior from reusable components.

sources.label: Fallout 3 GECK documentation - AI Packages

games.summary: NPC routines reflect occupation, location, relationships, ownership, and player conduct, while Radiant Story fills quest templates with suitable actors, relationships, and locations.
games.details: The story manager can respond to deaths, theft, dropped objects, skills, friendships, and grudges. It provides procedural variation within authored quest structures rather than unrestricted story generation.

sources.label: Game Informer - The technology behind Skyrim

games.developer: Art From The Machine / community project
games.summary: Players speak naturally to NPCs; speech is transcribed, an LLM produces an in-character response using game context, and text-to-speech voices the reply.
games.details: The original pipeline combined Whisper, ChatGPT, and xVASynth, with conversation summaries providing compact memory for future prompts. It is a third-party mod rather than an official Bethesda system and introduces moderation, privacy, voice-rights, and operating-cost considerations.

games.summary: Procedurally configured Orc captains persist across encounters, remember outcomes, reference prior events, gain rank or traits, develop scars, and turn player defeat into personal rivalries.
games.details: The system combines character generation, hierarchy simulation, memory flags, adaptive dialogue, and procedural progression to create player-specific antagonists and stories.

games.summary: The sequel extends persistent rivalries into followers, betrayals, tribes, bodyguards, overlords, dynamic fort leadership, and cross-player vendettas.
games.details: Longer-lived relationships and social roles turn the simulated Orc hierarchy into a source of recruitment stories, loyalty events, betrayal, and personalised stronghold conflicts.

sources.label: Game Developer - How Shadow of War's Nemesis System was designed

games.summary: Rockstar has not publicly confirmed a machine-learning NPC architecture for GTA VI. Claims that the game will ship with learning NPCs should currently be treated as speculation.
games.details: Take-Two patent activity describes technologies such as navigation and virtual-world behavior, but a patent does not prove that a feature is implemented in GTA VI. This entry deliberately separates verified product information from inference.

games.summary: Horse AI predicts terrain, avoids collisions and cliffs, selects gait-aware movement, synchronises rider animation, and responds to predators, gunfire, injury, fatigue, and treatment.
games.details: A utility-like motivation system changes animation and responsiveness according to the horse's internal state and environment. The wider game also uses large-scale authored NPC and wildlife simulation, but claims that characters freely change beliefs or learn remain unsupported.
games.documentReference: Page 1 - multidimensional NPCs and 200 animal species

games.summary: NPCs follow daily cycles and react to disrupted world conditions, using fallback plans when expected people, locations, or services are unavailable.
games.details: Warhorse described routines capable of producing unscripted outcomes from world state and player actions, such as selecting alternatives or reporting a dead character. Specific pre-release examples should not automatically be assumed to ship exactly as demonstrated.

sources.label: PC Gamer - Kingdom Come: Deliverance preview and AI interview

games.summary: A-Life maintains NPCs beyond the player's immediate area through lower-detail offline simulation, switching nearby actors into detailed online behavior.
games.details: Global navigation, encounters, goals, smart terrains, faction bases, and ambient routines create the impression of a living Zone. Some ambitious GOAP, inventory, and autonomous-quest features discussed during development were cut and are not attributed here to the retail game.

sources.label: Game Developer - Inside the AI of S.T.A.L.K.E.R.

games.summary: Computer civilisations use goal-oriented behavior-tree logic for multi-step planning, while historical and randomised leader agendas shape diplomacy and strategic personality.
games.details: The design includes technology-boost planning, agenda-driven relationships, and composed barbarian responses in which scouts can discover cities and trigger attack forces from camps.

sources.label: GamesBeat - Firaxis on Civilization VI AI
IGN - Hidden agendas and improved AI in Civilization VI

games.summary: An overarching crew AI groups NPCs and assigns roles during searches and combat, while an influence-map flooding algorithm creates plausible pursuit routes after guards lose sight of the player.
games.details: Individual agents retain local behavior, and a data-driven rule system selects attacks, dialogue, and animation. The result supports coordinated but readable stealth encounters.

sources.label: GDC Vault - Taking Back What's Ours: The AI of Dishonored 2
Game AI Pro - Flooding the Influence Map for Chase in Dishonored 2

games.game: Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain
games.summary: The game tracks recurring player tactics and changes enemy equipment and preparation, adding helmets, night vision, lights, snipers, cameras, mines, armor, or stronger weapons as counters.
games.details: Often called the Revenge System by players, this is best understood as persistent statistics and authored counter-rules rather than machine learning that invents new tactics.
games.documentReference: Page 1 - adapts to player tactics / pattern recognition

sources.label: Konami support - Enemy Preparedness in The Phantom Pain

games.namedSystem: Modular creature trackers and relationship tables
games.summary: Creatures operate within a persistent predator-prey ecosystem, using modules for prey, threats, friends, items, dens, and discomfort to prioritise hunting, fleeing, cooperation, and avoidance.
games.details: Procedural animation makes bodies react to terrain while relationship tables and species-specific behavior create an ecosystem that can continue without the player at its centre.

sources.label: Unity - Exploring procedural design in Rain World

games.summary: Selected multi-legged ARC machines use reinforcement-learned locomotion controllers rewarded for balance, target orientation, efficient movement, and imitation of authored animation.
games.details: Machine learning controls bounded locomotion behavior rather than combat strategy or live adaptation to a specific player. The game also uses contracted-actor text-to-speech for variable ping vocabulary such as item and location names.

sources.label: PCGamesN - Embark explains generative AI and ARC systems

games.publisher: Jonas Tyroller / FondGame / No Gravity Games
games.summary: The antagonist estimates the player's near-future movement and places spikes, projectiles, and traps in response, while automatic difficulty adjustment keeps the challenge aligned with performance.
games.details: Official descriptions substantiate predictive behavior but do not establish neural networks or machine learning. It is therefore classified conservatively as predictive game logic.

sources.label: Official Steam listing - Will You Snail?

games.summary: Kythera provides navigation, cover queries, spatial reasoning, avoidance, and behavior trees, while utility scoring selects fallback actions such as fleeing, crouching, or going prone.
games.details: Bots also use sight and sound perception, suppression, squad behavior, and reactions to bodies. This is a modern tactical implementation of authored AI rather than a large learned model.

GROUND BRANCH - AI overhaul technical preview

games.game: The Last of Us Part I
games.namedSystem: Remake AI engine and paired search behaviors
games.summary: The remake applies newer AI systems to formerly scripted encounters, including paired searches, investigation, topographical pathfinding, visibility probes, and improved flanking.
games.details: Companions evaluate cover and enemy sightlines more convincingly, reducing implausible movement while keeping encounters faithful to the original structure.
games.documentReference: Page 1 - The Last of Us Part I

sources.label: PlayStation Blog - Rebuilt gameplay and AI in The Last of Us Part I

games.game: The Last of Us Part II
games.summary: Enemies can hold partial knowledge of the player's location, enabling directional searches without omniscience, while companions assist with stealth kills, rescues, melee, and damage.
games.details: Naughty Dog also built modular melee AI for responsive close combat. The system focuses on believable awareness and coordination rather than machine learning.
games.documentReference: Page 1 - The Last of Us Part II

games.summary: The Director estimates survivor intensity and controls population, mob timing, special infected, bosses, and item placement to create structured but unpredictable pacing.
games.details: Navigation meshes and flow distance support spawning and movement, while NextBot controls survivor bots and infected. The Director is rule-based and testable rather than a machine-learning model.

sources.label: Valve - The AI Systems of Left 4 Dead

games.namedSystem: Director AI and Alien behavior tree
games.summary: A macro director regulates proximity and tension without directly revealing the player, while the Xenomorph's behavior tree uses perception, search, and pathfinding to hunt locally.
games.details: A menace gauge and progressively unlocked behaviors simulate adaptation while preserving uncertainty. It is a layered authored system, not a neural network learning the player at runtime.
games.documentReference: Page 1 - The Perfect Monster in Alien: Isolation

games.summary: Civilians, gangs, and police perceive incidents and react according to personality, faction, danger, and role, producing unscripted escalation chains.
games.details: Coordinator systems organise conversations, fights, arrests, and other multi-character activities, while pose matching helps characters enter contextual animation smoothly.

sources.label: Game AI Pro - Cinematic Gameplay in Watch Dogs 2

games.summary: The game generates recruitable Londoners with occupations, traits, homes, relationships, memories, and schedules, making relevant citizens persistent when players engage with them.
games.details: The Census, uprezzing, Deep Profiler, runtime mission casting, recasting, and player-attention systems turn ambient citizens into playable protagonists or recurring adversaries.

sources.label: Game Developer - How Watch Dogs: Legion's Play as Anyone simulation works

games.summary: The game generates geography, civilizations, centuries of history, creatures, culture, and art, then simulates agents pursuing work, needs, relationships, combat, and social activities.
games.details: Stories emerge from interacting simulation layers rather than authored plot branches or generative language models. Persistent histories give events and objects long-term context.

sources.label: Bay 12 Games - Dwarf Fortress features
GDC Vault - Dwarf Fortress: A 10-Year Retrospective

games.namedSystem: Cassandra, Phoebe, and Randy AI Storytellers
games.summary: AI Storytellers monitor colony conditions and select raids, weather, traders, and incidents to shape pacing, while colonists react to needs, moods, relationships, injuries, and surroundings.
games.details: Different storytellers apply different pacing philosophies. Event probability and adaptive scaling produce replayable narratives without generating free-form story text.

sources.label: Official RimWorld systems overview

games.summary: Autonomous squads and factions patrol, work, trade, fight, capture characters, and maintain settlements while the player is not treated as the world's central actor.
games.details: Faction and settlement states can change after key events, creating a persistent sandbox in which goals, jobs, relations, and world-state flags drive activity.

sources.label: Lo-Fi Games - About Kenshi

games.summary: Developers used Midjourney during production for ideation and some limited in-game or finishing artwork, contributing to the game's deliberately strange visual texture.
games.details: This is a production-pipeline use rather than a runtime gameplay mechanic. It illustrates the disclosure, provenance, copyright, and consumer-trust questions raised when generated imagery ships in a commercial game.

games.summary: Procedural systems construct planets, terrain, textures, vegetation, fauna, and populations so players can travel seamlessly from space to planetary surfaces.
games.details: The pipeline uses deterministic seeds, voxel-based terrain generation, polygonisation, texturing, population, and simulation. It is algorithmic procedural generation, not a modern generative foundation model.

games.summary: Players enter free-form actions and a language model generates the next story passage, enabling narrative paths beyond authored dialogue trees.
games.details: AI Dungeon 2 initially used a fine-tuned GPT-2 model trained on choose-your-own-adventure transcripts. The live service later adopted changing commercial and in-house models, memory systems, moderation, and scalable cloud deployment.

games.details: Scheduling, pathfinding, danger, suppression, behavioural risk, and event escalation interact to produce crowd behavior and institutional pressure from many individually simulated agents.

games.details: Predator modeling, scent, environmental awareness, pathfinding, and adaptive spawn settings create survival pressure. Hinterland has documented specific changes such as a wolf hold-ground state and wildlife navigation fixes.
